decisions.reason: The flagship digital anamnesis line sits close to the core and fits the firm's digitalization direction, so its option value remains high at low carrying cost.
The education institute builds on the established customer base, supports training resources, and costs little to maintain, so keeping the option is justified.
Remote screen sharing support is a low-cost, integral part of customer support whose value is reinforced by remote work trends.
The analytics dashboard extends the core software and its value for connected, efficient practices is still unfolding, so the option is worth keeping.
The complete practice bundle is close to the core offer and mainly repackages existing modules, so carrying it costs little.

The job and practice portal is distant from the core and competes with many other options for resources, but it is cheap to run and its value for practice founders remains uncertain, so the option is narrowly kept.
